summary: Volume held at about 10 hours, but exchange rate math is still the main leak. Three open mistakes there share one cause, the quote set up the wrong way round. This batch drills cross rates and parity first, then adds two portfolio risk checks.

patterns.title: Cross rates set up the wrong way round
patterns.detail: All 3 open mistakes in Exchange Rate Calculations come from lining up the quotes incorrectly, 2 formula errors and 1 calculation slip.
patterns.action: Before any FX question write both quotes as fractions, price currency over base currency, and cancel the shared currency on paper.

questions.stem: The GBP/USD spot rate is 0.8000 (pounds per US dollar) and the JPY/USD spot rate is 150.00 (yen per US dollar). The JPY/GBP cross rate is closest to
questions.explanation: JPY/GBP = (JPY/USD) / (GBP/USD) = 150.00 / 0.8000 = 187.50, the dollar cancels. A multiplies the quotes and C is the inverse quote, pounds per yen.

questions.stem: Two assets have standard deviations of 20% and 10% and a correlation of +1. A portfolio with 50% in each has a standard deviation closest to
questions.explanation: With perfect positive correlation the portfolio standard deviation is the weighted average, 0.5 × 20% + 0.5 × 10% = 15%. A assumes zero correlation and C adds the variances without weights.
